notes.title: Release Update: 1.0.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Guo checking in![/h1]

Here are some bug fixes and minor changes to EOS 27:


[u]v.1.0.0 Bug Fixes:[/u]
- Hitboxes on mobs that were not meant to be visible are now hidden.
- The player no longer spawns with an IrAM chip upon first loading the game.
- The player can no longer enter the mole miniboss arena after having beaten it already.
- Main Menu no longer says the version is Closed Beta v.0.1 or whatever it was.



[u]v.1.0.0 Gameplay Changes (Spoilers marked): [/u]
- Added arrows to guide players to the house after beating the mole miniboss. [i](Sorry to all you guys who thought the game ended after beating the mole! I swear my game is longer than 12 minutes!)[/i]
- [spoiler]The final cutscene can now be replayed: The generator in the final arena will now always be destructible.[/spoiler]



That's all for this update. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
[h1]This is Guo, checking in![/h1]

Today, [b]EOS 27[/b] has officially released on the Steam Store. I hope that all of you have fun playing!

Here are some known bugs about the game. I'll work to have these fixed in the next patch. (Spoilers tagged):
 - The game says it's in version v0.1. Oops. I must have forgotten to change that text.
 - Immediately after defeating the mole boss, going to its arena again will cause its fight to repeat.
 - Debugging Hitboxes on some mobs are visible.
 - [spoiler] After beating the final boss a second time, the generator will not respawn, preventing you from initiating the end sequence / cutscene. [/spoiler]

As more bugs are discovered, they will be documented and fixed accordingly. If you have any comments or suggestions about the game or have a bug to report, shoot me an email at [u]developerjjg@gmail.com[/u]. Your feedback is very, very much appreciated.

Most importantly, have fun playing! :D
